mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing mainly clear skies and a pleasant 70 degrees that feels like 73 near the Verona Public Library. If you look up tonight at 9:31 PM, you will have a clear six-minute view of the International Space Station crossing the sky under a waxing crescent moon.

The City of Verona has announced multiple green initiatives, including financial rebates for installing residential rain barrels and low-flow toilets to promote water conservation. Additionally, apartment residents are encouraged to compost by using the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop located on East Verona Avenue.

There are great local events coming up. On July 19th, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Later in the week, mark your calendar for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July 22nd, at Hometown Junction Park.

In police news, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at County Road PB and American Way where a 16-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield the right-of-way, resulting in minor injuries to another driver.

Wrap up your day with a sweet treat. Today's Culver's flavor of the day is the classic Turtle, featuring rich caramel and pecans. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to head over, and tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
